verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first Rust game engine and app framework. It has no concept of user-defined 'automations' that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back as a product feature, so this workflow-automation axis is a category error for this kind of product. Any versioning of Bevy projects would come from the user's own source control, not from Bevy itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
